description: VAT number validation, EU VAT number format checker. Check whether a VAT number has the right format for its country (all EU countries, Northern Ireland XI, UK GB, Switzerland CHE, Norway NO). Format only: it does not confirm the business is registered. Send it with the country prefix, e.g. DE123456789. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
